generation.kind: procedural synthetic receipts with explicit watermarks
generation.pixel_sources: Procedural paper/background and rendered font glyphs; no captured receipt images or crops composited.
generation.text_sources: Store names, address prefixes and item names are sampled from a text bank built from existing receipt annotations. Phone digits and street numbers are randomly generated.

decoded_rgb_hash_definition: sha256(ASCII RGB:<width>:<height>: followed by row-major RGB uint8 pixel bytes)

questions_per_image: 영수증의 가게 위치에서 도로명 뒤 숫자는 무엇입니까?

reference_quantization.scope: These are the exact initial calibration images from the 2026-10-27 comparison. This data release is not a complete reproduction of that experiment. The repository fresh-PTQ build uses VolvoxAI and its own question and decoder-prefix recipe.

annotations.source: Unchanged labels generated for the corresponding synthetic image; geometry is preserved by the photometric renderer.
annotations.answers: Receipt contents and generation/layout metadata. Optional fields depend on the receipt.
annotations.fields: Rendered text fields, word/field polygons and glyph polygons in original image pixel coordinates.
